findings.claim: 公司在 FY2026 Q3 財報稿稱，因新專案導入與市占率提升，上調 FY2026 營收成長預期至逾 20%（公司自述，非第三方份額數據）。
findings.source: Barchart／Plexus 新聞稿 Plexus Announces Fiscal Third Quarter Financial Results
findings.excerpt: For fiscal 2026, we now anticipate generating in excess of 20% revenue growth due to Plexus' success in launching numerous new programs and our market share gains combined with improved end market demand.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：製造流程缺乏重大專利保護，資源更大的公司可能進入市場；客戶亦可能自製；競爭加劇可能導致降價或失去客戶／份額。
findings.excerpt: Our manufacturing processes are generally not subject to significant proprietary protection, and companies with greater resources or a greater market presence may enter our market or otherwise become increasingly competitive. Increased competition could result in significant price reductions, reduced sales and margins, or loss of customers or market share.

findings.claim: 10-K Item 1：競爭者可能提供類似服務、部分在特定產業更成熟或資源更大；Plexus 亦與客戶自有產能競爭。
findings.excerpt: A number of competitors may provide services similar to Plexus. Others may be more established in certain industry sectors, or have greater financial, manufacturing or marketing resources.

note: 搜尋未找到獨立第三方份額數據或具名新進入者／對手搶單的 2026 報導；份額上升僅見公司自述。第四次搜尋未使用。
